name: primary-source-verification
description: primary-source-verification (psv) — read-only, source-grounded, per-claim verifier that fetches each cited primary source and adjudicates a doc's factual/citation claims (verified/refuted/narrowed/unverifiable), emitting an honest coverage disclosure (oracle_verified_under_known_coverage). Single extract→fetch→verdict→coverage pipeline (NOT a multi-round debate); the fetched source TEXT is the oracle. Additive to cross-source-review (process axis). NEVER correctness_converged. Phase A: explicit invocation; no hooks of its own (the pipeline is orchestrator-driven, not hook-driven).
